decision.recommended_next_gate_policy: Do not trust full local CV alone. Require any future candidate to beat ID342 on the best stable public-alignment lens, preserve the recent slate order where relevant, and explicitly report behavior with ID287 and ID329 excluded so the gate is not driven by failed-frontier artifacts.
